title.V-MODEL-TYPE: Model does not match type code
title.V-TIME-OFFSET: UTC offset does not match the airport
title.V-TRACK-ROUTE: Track does not fit the route
title.V-REG-COUNTRY: Registration country differs from airline country
title.C-TYPE-MISMATCH: Type code differs from the aircraft's

title.C-SAME-DAY: Flown and photographed on the same day
fix.moveTakeoff: {landing, select, yes {Move takeoff and landing to the next day ({date})} other {Move takeoff to the next day ({date})}}
regFormat: {registration} does not match any known national registration format.
regCountry: {registration} is registered in {country}, and the airline is from {airlineCountry}. Common with leased aircraft.
typeKnown: {typeCode} is not an ICAO type designator.
modelParse: The model "{model}" could not be read.
modelType: {label}: model {model} does not match type code {typeCode}.
modelTypeFits: {label}: model {model} does not match type code {typeCode}. The model fits {types}.
privateInNotes: The notes seem to contain a ticket number. Move it to the private ticket field?
dateBeforeFlight: {label}: {date} is before the first powered flight.
dateFuture: {label}: {date} is in the future. Only flown flights and past sightings are logged.
beforeFirstFlight: {label} is dated before the aircraft's first flight ({date}).
flightNumberFormat: {flightNumber} is not a flight number (airline code + 1–4 digits).
seatFormat: {label}: seat {seat} is not a row number and a letter.
timeOffset: {label}: {value} has offset {offset}, but the airport's time zone ({tz}) was {expected} then.
dayRolloverDays: {label}: takeoff on {date} is {days} days from the scheduled date.
dayRolloverEarly: {label}: takeoff at {clock} on the scheduled date. If the flight left after midnight, it took off on {date}.
scheduleDate: {label}: the scheduled departure is on {day}, but the flight's date, the day it was scheduled to leave, is {date}.
trackTimes: {label}: {problem} Correct the flight's date and times, or replace the track.
trackRoute: {label}: {problem} Correct the airports, or replace the track.
speed: {label}: {km} km in {hours}h {minutes}m is {kmh} km/h on average. Check the airports, dates and times.
distance: {label}: the distance entered ({entered} km) differs from the great-circle distance ({greatCircle} km).
typeMismatch: {registrations} is recorded as {typeCode} here, but the aircraft is a {aircraftType}. A typo, or a different aircraft with the same registration?
typeMismatchRecords: {registrations} is recorded as {typeCode} here, but {count, plural, one {# other record of this aircraft says} other {# other records of this aircraft say}} {aircraftType}. A typo, or a different aircraft with the same registration?
regOverlap: {registration} is held by {count, plural, one {# aircraft} other {# aircraft}} on this date. Fix the registration periods or choose the aircraft.
dupFlight: {label} is logged {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}.
dupSighting: {label} is logged {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} at the same place. One sighting per aircraft per place per day is usual. Keep both only if intended.
dupTicket: {flights} have the same ticket number and coupon. One coupon is probably mistyped.
codeVariants: {spellings} are the same code. They are counted as one ({code}).
liveryMissing: {aircraft} was in {livery} on {date}, but {table, select, flights {this flight} other {this sighting}} has no special livery.
sameDay: You photographed {registration} on the day you flew on it ({flight}).
